newsitem.title: USA: AutoLend Group accepts note exchange.
newsitem.headline: AutoLend Group accepts note exchange.

text.p: AutoLend Group Inc said on Wednesday it had accepted for exchange all of the 9.5 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 1997 that were validly tendered and not withdrawn in the company's exchange offer.
The exchange offer had expired on April 8, 1997 and the total principal face value of debentures tendered was $7.2 million.
Under the exchange offer, approximately 1.4 million new shares of common stock and 58,000 shares of preferred stock will be issued, AutoLend said.
